title: Reliability-Aware Sexism Detection: Combining DPO with Annotator Agreement and Token-Level Confidence Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2608.12330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The detection of online sexism remains an open problem. Sexism detection is inherently subjective, yet most existing systems reduce multi-annotator labels to a single majority decision and treat all instances uniformly. This ignores two informative signals: annotator agreement and model uncertainty. We propose RA-DPO (Reliability-Aware Direct Preference Optimization), which integrates annotator agreement, model confidence, and a token-level uncertainty signal into a single reliability score. RA-DPO uses this score to select high-value preference pairs during training and to support inference-time abstention, which allows the model to trade coverage for accuracy. We evaluate RA-DPO on 6,920 multilingual posts from EXIST 2023, fine-tune OpenAI gpt-4o base via DPO, and validate on two open-weight 3B models (Llama, Qwen). translated_title: 可靠性感知的性别歧视检测：结合DPO与标注者一致性和词级置信度评分
translated_abstract: 在线性别歧视的检测仍然是一个未解决的问题。性别歧视检测本质上是主观的，但大多数现有系统将多标注者的标签简化为单一的多数决策，并统一对待所有实例。这忽略了两个信息丰富的信号：标注者一致性和模型不确定性。我们提出了RA-DPO（可靠性感知直接偏好优化），它将标注者一致性、模型置信度和词级不确定性信号整合为一个单一的可靠性评分。RA-DPO利用该评分在训练期间选择高价值的偏好对，并支持推理时的弃权，从而使模型能够以覆盖率为代价换取准确性。我们在EXIST 2023的6,920条多语言帖子上评估了RA-DPO，通过DPO微调OpenAI gpt-4o基础模型，并在两个开放权重的3B模型（Llama、Qwen）上进行了验证。结果表明，在最高30%最可靠的配对上进行训练与全数据DPO效果相当，这表明可靠性感知方法能够高效利用数据。
tldr: 本文提出RA-DPO方法，通过整合标注者一致性、模型置信度和词级不确定性来提升性别歧视检测的可靠性，并证明在少量高可靠性数据上训练即可达到全数据训练的同等效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RA-DPO, which integrates annotator agreement, model confidence, and token-level uncertainty to enhance reliability in sexism detection, demonstrating that training on a small set of high-reliability data matches full-data DPO performance.
